tasks.short: Adapt or design computing hardware or software for medical science

steps.what: Establish actual medical-science use requirements, interfaces, data constraints and acceptance conditions
inputs: actual research/user requirements and existing system interfaces
actual intended-use and data constraints
outputs: engineer-checked computing requirements and acceptance conditions

steps.what: Design the actual hardware/software adaptation, architecture and interfaces for the medical-science use
inputs: engineer-checked computing requirements and acceptance conditions
actual existing hardware/software and interface specifications
outputs: engineer's actual computing design and implementation brief

steps.what: Implement and inspect the actual adaptation or prototype from the engineer's design
inputs: engineer's actual computing design and implementation brief
actual existing implementation and permitted component interfaces
outputs: engineer-inspected implementation candidate with source changes

loop.purpose: Suggest bounded software implementation changes within the engineer's design
loop.input: actual interface specification, engineer's implementation brief and permitted existing source
loop.output: proposed source changes with explicit assumptions and associated test suggestions
loop.check: engineer inspects data semantics, units, error handling, dependencies and adherence to the actual design; independent execution/acceptance checks follow in s4
loop.stop: missing interface detail, unexplained dependency, untestable change or hardware-only work returns to manual implementation
loop.why_not_simpler: native configuration is tried first but cannot express every required source-code adaptation

steps.what: Test the actual implementation against the acceptance conditions and inspect failures until the exact final design/implementation package is checked
inputs: engineer-inspected implementation candidate with source changes
engineer-checked computing requirements and acceptance conditions
actual test environment and test evidence
outputs: complete checked computing design/implementation package version

steps.what: Commit the exact checked package to the internal engineering project repository
inputs: complete checked computing design/implementation package version

tasks.design: Try native component configuration in {OTHER}, the engineering development/test environment, before bounded assistance on actual software source changes. The engineer determines the design, inspects proposed implementation and tests the exact final package before its internal repository commit; no clinical deployment is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source implementation can require repeated interface and error-handling code beyond native configuration.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded code suggestions can assist an actual engineer-authored design when complete interface context is available.
tasks.still_hard: Correct execution does not prove correct medical-science meaning or suitability for intended use.
tasks.human_edge: Define the design and acceptance evidence and recognise consequential semantic errors.

ambition.what: No new clinical authority or deployed medical system assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for permitted source/data processing and engineering access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded source-code assistance can support implementation while engineers retain architecture, semantic inspection and acceptance testing.

assumptions: Shares are a provisional software-adaptation scenario, not measured baselines. Hardware-only design receives no code-assistance saving.

OTHER means development tools, test environment and engineering repository. Users/research owners supply actual requirements; the engineer produces the checked design in s1/s2. Missing interfaces stop assisted implementation.

No patient data or new structured clinical dataset is assumed; approved synthetic/deidentified test fixtures must already be suitable for the test. Native configuration precedes custom source changes.
Gross provisional saving 7.5 minus 2 hours of permitted source packaging and assistance-rule upkeep gives 5.5 net; existing equivalent support removes the gain.
Commit is negligible and fully retained. Any implementation edit invalidates s4's checked version; release/deployment and required independent product approval are not automated or claimed.
unknowns: Actual hardware/software mix and intended use
Permitted source processing and existing test coverage
research_questions: Does bounded assistance reduce total implementation work after semantic inspection and acceptance testing on real adaptations?

already_counted.description: Inspect source changes and perform full acceptance checks

incremental.description: Package permitted source context and maintain/test bounded assistance instructions

approvals.approved_version: complete checked computing design/implementation package version

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 5.5%; hardware work or extensive code correction removes the gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read and check actual experiment records, sample identifiers, protocols and result-file provenance
inputs: researchers' actual experiment and sample records
actual instrument result files and method records

steps.what: Enter or update actual experiment characteristics and results in the database, preserving identity, units and source references
inputs: engineer-checked experiment/result source set
existing experiment-database field definitions

steps.what: Check the complete update against the source records, resolve duplicates or mismatches and verify database consistency
inputs: completed experiment-database update draft
engineer-checked experiment/result source set

steps.what: Commit the completed checked update to the existing experiment database
inputs: complete checked experiment-database update version

tasks.design: Configure native import staging and field mappings in {OTHER}, the existing experiment/laboratory database, for actual supported instrument exports. The engineer still captures non-exported characteristics, checks source provenance and validates the complete update before committing it; no missing experiment fact is inferred.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual result-file fields can be transcribed into an experiment database repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native staged imports can reuse supported existing export fields deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: Sample identity, method changes, units and duplicate experiments require substantive reconciliation.
tasks.human_edge: Know whether the stored result truly belongs to the stated experiment and conditions.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6 for experiment-data permissions and approved import configuration

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native staged laboratory-data imports can reduce supported result-field transcription while engineers retain provenance and consistency checking.

assumptions: Shares are provisional human database-maintenance effort, not experiment runtime or a measured baseline.

OTHER means the existing experiment/laboratory database and instrument-file viewer. Researchers already record experiment ID, sample ID, protocol/condition and time; instrument exports supply parameter, value and unit with sample identity where supported.
Only existing supported structured fields are imported. Non-exported characteristics and absent metadata are entered manually inside retained s2; no free new structured capture is assumed.
Missing identifiers, changed units or duplicate keys stop staging for manual resolution. Native configuration is tested before custom integration; existing equivalent imports remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 18 minus 2 hours of mapping/schema upkeep gives 16 net. Final commit is negligible and fully retained.
unknowns: Actual export schemas and current manual transcription
research_questions: Which real result fields can existing native imports stage with correct sample identity and units?

already_counted.description: Capture remaining characteristics and validate the complete staged update against actual sources

incremental.description: Maintain export/schema mappings and test method/unit changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 16%; incomplete exports or existing imports can remove the gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define the actual modelling question, assumptions, variables, statistical approach and validation criteria
inputs: actual biomedical research question and intended model use
actual available evidence and methodological constraints
outputs: engineer's model specification and validation criteria

steps.what: Inspect and prepare the actual data or simulation parameters, including missingness, units and experimental structure
inputs: engineer's model specification and validation criteria
actual research data or supported simulation parameters

steps.what: Implement the specified statistical model or simulation and run the chosen analysis using statistical or modelling software
inputs: engineer's model specification and validation criteria
engineer-checked model inputs and limitations
outputs: actual implemented model and analysis outputs with settings

steps.what: Validate and interpret the actual model, diagnostics and sensitivity results and check the final model package
inputs: actual implemented model and analysis outputs with settings
engineer's model specification and validation criteria
engineer-checked model inputs and limitations

steps.what: Save the completed checked model/simulation package in the research workspace
inputs: complete checked statistical-model/simulation package version

tasks.design: Configure native reusable analysis/model components in {OTHER}, the existing statistical or simulation application, for the engineer's actual selected method. The engineer defines the model, prepares inputs and validates the full result; only repeated implementation/setup handling changes before the checked package is saved.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated model component and analysis setup can accompany methodological development.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable components can implement already-selected standard methods.
tasks.still_hard: Model assumptions, confounding, identifiability and applicability require statistical judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise that a fitted or executable model can answer the wrong question.

ambition.what: No automatic scientific inference or clinical decision proposed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for permitted data and model-library access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native statistical/simulation components can reduce repeated setup while engineers select methods and validate scientific applicability.

assumptions: Shares are provisional human work, not solver runtime or measured baseline evidence.

OTHER means statistical/simulation software. Actual researchers/instruments produce the source data; the engineer checks parameters and data in s2. Missing values or unsupported parameters require explicit methodological decisions.
Only repeated implementation/setup changes; formula execution already supplied by today's software earns no new saving. Existing equivalent components remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 5 minus 1.5 hours of component/configuration validation upkeep gives 3.5 net. Model design, data inspection and final interpretation remain fully retained.
The final save is negligible and fully retained, with no deployment or automatic recommendation.
unknowns: Current reusable component coverage and real setup effort
research_questions: Which real model-development steps repeat setup beyond current native statistical routines?

already_counted.description: Inspect implementation outputs and validate/interpret the complete model

incremental.description: Maintain reusable model configurations and test software/component changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 3.5%; novel model methods may offer no reusable setup gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read current scientific and trade literature

steps.what: Find and select actual current publications relevant to the engineer's biomedical topics
inputs: actual biomedical topics of interest
existing scientific/trade publication index records

steps.what: Read and critically assess the selected literature to understand actual scientific, industrial and technological advances
inputs: engineer-selected actual publications
actual accessible publication texts
outputs: engineer's actual understanding of advances and their evidence limits

tasks.design: Configure native topic/date filters in {OTHER}, the scientific and trade-literature index, to shorten discovery of actual publications. The engineer still selects and reads the source text critically; no generated digest replaces reading and no automatic alert/send is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated broad literature searches can slow discovery of relevant new material.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed filters can narrow the actual publication list.
tasks.still_hard: Relevance, methods and evidence quality require reading the real work.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a useful advance from an unsupported or inapplicable claim.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native literature-index filters can reduce discovery navigation without replacing critical reading.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and unmeasured. OTHER means existing scientific/trade literature indexes and readers.
Publishers/index providers supply actual title, date, topic and source identifiers; missing or misleading metadata requires manual search and reading.
Only discovery navigation changes. Existing equivalent filters remove the gain; no new structured evidence database or written report is assumed.
Gross provisional saving 3 minus 0.5 hour of topic-filter upkeep gives 2.5 net.
unknowns: Current search configuration and actual discovery effort
research_questions: Do actual literature searches repeat navigation that native topic/date filters can remove?

already_counted.description: Inspect and select actual search results

incremental.description: Review topic/date filter settings as interests change

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 2.5%; all actual critical reading remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated implementation and data handling while retaining biomedical design, experiment provenance and scientific judgment.
